To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the university should not only pay attention to the alliance with enterprise, but also should not forget its unique pursuit of truth and knowledge.
the relation between university & enterprise is a double-sided coin.
the relation between universityand enterprise is not a simple one, it is the relation of alliance and colonization at the same time.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: 1. What are the different discourse space and logic between the university and commerce? 2. What is the "awkward predicaments" that university is under? 3. What is the realistic choice that university should make in the "awkward situation"?
the relation between university, enterprise and society, the research of university and the research of enterprise, the research of enterprise and the research of society.

the following questions: 1) What is the relation of the university and the enterprise?2) How to understand the relation of the two?3) How to make the university face the relation with the enterprise?4) How to make our research on the university in the future?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
university is the "knowledge" and "truth" that are produced by the society and for the society,and university is also the "enterprise" which has the same characteristics as the enterprise.
the university should not be colonized, nor should it be an ally of the enterprise.
the university should be a kind of "enterprise" which has a strong sense of social responsibility and the ability of innovation,which is the most ideal choice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the university should take the lead in building the alliance between university and enterprise and the cooperation between university and enterprise.

university should be a "third party",it is the third party between the government and the enterprise,as a result,university should be the "mediator" between them,that is,university should not only be a "mediator",it should be a "mediating university".
the university is the place of knowledge production, the university and the enterprise is in the same knowledge production system, but they are in different position in the system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have to be aware of our own "awkward situation",we should not only pay attention to our own interests,also pay more attention to the pursuit of truth and the development of science.
we should not only consider the alliance and cooperation between university and commerce from the perspective of university, but also from the perspective of the society.

the university should make the choice of strengthening the alliance and cooperating with the enterprise,while maintaining its unique pursuit of truth and knowledge,which is not only a choice that the modern universities should make, but also the theme that the study of modern universities need to think.
